personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT (with Dark-First Utility operational cues)
personality_one_liner: Operational kitchen clarity meets botanical warmth — a scan-friendly caterer workspace built for live queues, offline billing, and menu control.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial vertical rhythm combined with compact operational padding for kitchen queues and order cards.

do's: Use translucent frosted glass for sticky queue filters and bottom tab bar over scrolling lists
Apply 75% surface tint underneath blur for strict kitchen readability
dont's: Never blur form fields or menu management inputs
Do not use heavy blur on live order status badges

screens.name: CatererLogin
screens.purpose: Secure staff entry with Staff ID/Email and role selection.

states.empty: Please enter valid staff credentials to access kitchen workspace.
states.error: Invalid Staff ID or network failure. Please retry.

screens.layout: Clean editorial card centered on botanical background with secure input fields, role picker, and sticky login CTA.

screens.name: CatererDashboard
screens.purpose: Operational command center showing live kitchen metrics, daily earnings, and quick queue summary.

states.loading: Syncing kitchen orders and offline DB...
states.empty: No orders for today yet. Tap '+' to create a manual offline order.
states.error: Failed to sync orders. Working in offline database mode.

screens.layout: Header with caterer profile status, earnings hero card with quick stats, today's queue preview shelf, and offline sync indicator.

screens.name: OrderQueue
screens.purpose: Live kitchen order queue with filter tabs (All, New, Prep, Ready, Done) and 1-tap state transitions.

states.empty: Queue is clear! All active orders have been completed.
states.error: Could not load order queue. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky glass filter row at top followed by vertical list of high-contrast order cards with instant action buttons (Accept, Prepare, Ready, Complete).

screens.name: OrderDetail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific order showing items, modifiers, customer notes, pickup time, payment status, and direct customer phone contact.
screens.layout: Modal/Stack screen with customer contact header, ordered items breakdown with pricing, customer notes callout box, and bottom sticky status progression bar.

screens.name: MenuManagement
screens.purpose: Catalog manager for catering dishes with real-time price updates and instant availability toggles.

states.empty: No catering items found. Add your first dish below.
states.error: Failed to sync menu updates with server.

screens.layout: Search & category filter bar, item cards with price badges, stock availability switches, and floating 'Add New Dish' action button.

screens.name: ManualOrderModal
screens.purpose: Offline billing and manual order creation tool storing orders directly in the local SQLite/backend database.

states.empty: Add items to create manual billing order.
states.error: Failed to save offline billing record.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet form with customer name, phone, item selector, payment method dropdown, and sticky 'Save & Print Bill' CTA.

screens.name: SalesSummary
screens.purpose: Daily earnings breakdown, revenue charts, and financial export tools.

states.empty: No sales recorded for this period.

screens.layout: Earnings hero summary card, daily sales breakdown list, payment method distribution bars, and offline sync log.

caterer_hero.alt: Botanical forest green texture representing the campcook caterer workspace

empty_queue.alt: Lush green foliage representing an empty calm kitchen queue

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the caterer workspace mobile screens inside /app/frontend/app/caterer or equivalent modular folders integrated with existing Expo app structure (/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx).
Ensure the caterer tab is visible in bottom navigation when logged in as caterer, alongside a separate Caterer Web Dashboard mock view accessible from settings.
Implement the live order queue with Accept, Preparing, Ready, and Completed state transitions with instant UI feedback and haptic triggers.
Connect offline billing order creation to the local database / backend server (/app/backend/server.py) so offline orders persist reliably.
Strictly maintain the CampCook botanical green look with dense operational kitchen controls and scan-friendly cards, avoiding any generic purple/indigo AI aesthetics.
